== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes are unable to use this skill effectively. They do not consider the number of summoned creatures needed to reach the energy cap. As such, they may use it after creating only a single creature, even if they have the potential to create more. 
* Heroes also do not consider that this skill is limited to earshot range. They may use it while none of their creatures are within range, wasting the skill in its entirety.

== Notes ==

* The skill counts [[spirit]]s and [[minion]]s, but does not count creatures summoned by [[Asura summon]]ing skills, [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support]], or by [[summoning stone]]s.

== Trivia ==
